siteMeta.aboutLead: Skillcetera - Skills and Languages Club is not just an academic club; it is a vibrant event-organizing hub that empowers students to thrive through the exchange of knowledge, skills, and experiences. Our vision is to create an engaging environment where creativity and collaboration flourish, allowing members to enhance their knowledge and develop essential skills in a supportive community.

missions.descriptionVi: Building a knowledge-sharing community that nurtures ideas daily, using consistency as the foundation to unlock flexible adaptability.
missions.detailVi: At Skillcetera, we act as a catalyst for personal growth and community empowerment. The club's mission is to create a space for 'Ideas worth spreading — Knowledge worth sharing', where ideas are celebrated, knowledge is shared, and consistency unlocks flexible thinking.

missions.descriptionVi: Organizing meticulous, engaging, educational, and inspiring events that reach far beyond university campus grounds.
missions.detailVi: Skillcetera takes pride in professional event organizing capabilities that have established a reputation beyond FPT University. Every initiative is thoroughly invested from academic quality and stage directing to attendee experience.

missions.descriptionVi: An environment that respects diversity, encourages open dialogue, and stands together so that every member is heard and empowered.
missions.detailVi: We value diversity, mutual respect, and open communication. The club welcomes every individual with their unique personality, perspectives, and ideas, cultivating an empathetic culture of mutual support.

esc.name: ESC
esc.headline: Your voice. Your impact.
esc.description: An academic arena for university and college students nationwide to confidently express critical thinking, stage presence, and personal voice in English.
esc.detailOverview: English Speaking Competition (ESC) is an annual speech and debate tournament hosted by Skillcetera, bringing together contestants from over 20 universities and colleges. The competition inspires youth to 'Break The Norm' and use language as a catalyst to amplify independent perspectives and solutions for social challenges.

rounds.title: Shaping Personal Voice
rounds.desc: Contestants submit video and written entries presenting independent viewpoints on the season's open academic theme.

rounds.title: Direct Dialogue & Debate
rounds.desc: Contestants deliver on-stage keynote speeches and engage in live defense with the academic judging panel.

rounds.title: Break The Norm Final Showdown
rounds.desc: Top finalists compete through keynote speeches and 1v1 debate showdowns on the grand stage before hundreds of attendees.

esc.imageAlt: Skillcetera English Speaking Competition Grand Final Show documentation
esc.sourceNote: Official academic competition scale documented across seasons in Skillcetera club archives.

tedx.name: TEDxFPTUniversityHCMC
tedx.headline: Ideas move. People change.
tedx.description: Stories that spark fresh perspectives. Skillcetera serves as the primary organizing unit of TEDxFPTUniversityHCMC across seasons from 2021 to 2025.
tedx.detailOverview: As the primary organizing licensee for TEDxFPTUniversityHCMC, Skillcetera creates a gathering place where multidisciplinary speakers and university students meet through ideas worth spreading. Club archives record 5 consecutive seasons from 2021 to 2025.
tedx.sourceNote: Event and media metrics are specific to TEDxFPTUniversityHCMC in club records (retrieved Oct 24, 2026). Source text notes 'four seasons' while cataloging 5 full seasons from 2021 to 2025.

2021.description: The debut edition in Skillcetera's TEDxFPTUniversityHCMC catalog, laying the first milestone for ideas worth spreading at FPT University HCMC.

2022.description: Conversations on evolving perspectives, personal core values, and how young generations adapt to emerging societal shifts.

2023.description: Exploring boundaries between having and letting go, holding on and moving forward to define one's authentic path.

2024.description: Every monumental shift begins with small, persistent steps — the edition spotlighting Season 04: Big Things Start Small.
2024.statusNote: Historical archive with Season 04 visual identity (2024).

2025.description: Theme of TEDxFPTUniversityHCMC 2025 in Skillcetera's catalog, championing the courage to pursue ideas to the very end.
2025.statusNote: Latest recorded season in club archives; next season announcement pending.

2023.description: Established the benchmark 3-round academic competition framework and student public speaking excellence.

2024.description: Marked an expansive scale of inter-university collaboration across partner institutions nationwide.

2025.description: An academic arena bringing together top talents from 20+ universities, asserting bold critical thinking and fluent English debate.
2025.statusNote: Latest recorded season in club archives; next season announcement pending.

discussion.title: Discussion Forum
discussion.description: An open academic dialogue space between members and invited guests on diverse topics, where every viewpoint is heard and challenged constructively.
discussion.detailText: Discussion Forum is Skillcetera's regular thematic panel series, connecting club members with experienced speakers, lecturers, and industry guests (covering Education, Employment, critical thinking, and career skills). It is the cradle for active listening and sharp reasoning.
discussion.metricsLabel: Academic Forum · Periodic dialogues with members & guests

scavenger.title: Scavenger Hunt
scavenger.description: An urban exploration race across Saigon's culture, history, and geography through hands-on challenges requiring strong teamwork.
scavenger.detailText: Scavenger Hunt takes participants out onto the streets of Saigon to decipher cryptic clues and challenges tied to the city's heritage and culture. Across 6 seasons, it blends physical teamwork with deep local discovery.
scavenger.metricsLabel: 6 seasons organized · 50+ participants per season · 10+ locations across Saigon

retreat.title: Meditation Retreat
retreat.description: A mindful retreat into nature to practice meditation, self-reflect, and nurture inner balance.
retreat.detailText: Amid vibrant study and event schedules, Meditation Retreat offers a serene pause for members and attendees to reconnect with nature, practice mindfulness, listen within, and share openly. Club records document 3 meaningful seasons.
retreat.metricsLabel: 3 recorded seasons · Nature immersion & personal growth

store.title: S-Store
store.description: Fundraising merchandise conceived and designed by Skillcetera members: t-shirts, lanyards, tote bags, and badges.
store.detailText: S-Store is Skillcetera's official merchandise project where members conceptualize, design, and produce branded apparel and accessories (including collaborative drops with Coolmate). Over 500 lanyards, 100+ t-shirts, and 100+ tote bags sold.
store.metricsLabel: Sold: 500+ lanyards · 100+ t-shirts · 100+ tote bags (per source archive)

moneyverse.title: The MoneyVerse
moneyverse.description: Partnering in financial literacy and investment education for youth produced by VTV Times as campus relations and student ambassador partners.
moneyverse.detailText: The MoneyVerse is a financial and investment education series combining entertainment and technology for youth, produced by VTV Times (Vietnam Television). Skillcetera collaborated in campus relations, student ambassador coordination, and club networking across 10 southern university campuses.
moneyverse.metricsLabel: Partnership scope: 10 Southern university campuses (VTV Times)
